t: This is Whitehall Court, one continuous building made of two separate constructions. The southern end was designed by Thomas Archer and A. Green as luxury apartments in 1884. The northern end, home to the National Liberal Club, was designed by Alfred Waterhouse and finished in 1887. Waterhouse is best known for Manchester Town Hall and the Natural History Museum. The ninth Duke of Newcastle, a peer and aviator, was born here.
